PM5E.Import.Title: Import from Mephistopheles Terminal
PM5E.Import.Hint: Paste a macro or JSON from the site (the “Foundry” button in the Knowledge Base, “TO FOUNDRY” in the builder) or pick a file. Everything goes to the “Mephistopheles Terminal” folder; documents imported before are updated.
PM5E.Import.Bad: This doesn't look like Mephistopheles Terminal data: use a macro or JSON from the site.
PM5E.Import.Fail: Mephistopheles Terminal: import failed, see the console (F12).
PM5E.Settings.SiteUrlHint: The Mephistopheles Terminal site: the “On the site” button in the Knowledge Base and links in descriptions.
PM5E.Settings.LiveCanonHint: The Knowledge Base loads fresh canon from the site's database (Firestore). Off or offline — the module's built-in copy.
PM5E.Settings.OpenLinksHint: “Open in the Knowledge Base” links in descriptions open the Knowledge Base window in Foundry instead of the site.
PM5E.KB.Title: Mephistopheles Knowledge Base
PM5E.KB.Pick: Pick a record on the left.
PM5E.KB.NoActor: Select a token or assign yourself a character
PM5E.KB.NotFound: Not found in the Knowledge Base: {name}
PM5E.KB.StatusNote: This is not an applied status but an instant effect or reference: use the buttons on the token's status panel (Tremor Burst, Deluge).
PM5E.Settings.StatusAutomationHint: Damage and stack decay at round start, turn start and turn end (Burn, Poison, Sinking…), Bleed on actions and movement. Reported to chat.
PM5E.Settings.HudStatusesHint: Project Moon status icons in the token menu palette (a click adds 1 stack). Requires a reload.
PM5E.Settings.StatusTrayHint: A panel with stacks for the selected token: +/−, remove, Tremor Burst, Deluge…
PM5E.Status.BurstSave: Constitution save DC {dc}, on a fail — Staggered
PM5E.Status.BurstLow: Tremor Burst needs at least 10 stacks.
PM5E.Status.NoTokens: Select the tokens to apply the status to.
PM5E.Ego.Title: Light and E.G.O.
PM5E.Ego.NoEgo: No E.G.O. — the builder's “TO FOUNDRY” brings them over.
PM5E.Ego.NoGifts: No gifts — give them from the Knowledge Base or the builder.
PM5E.Ego.NoOptions: No suitable tier {tier} gifts in the Knowledge Base.
PM5E.Ego.FuseBad: Fusion needs 2 or 3 gifts with a known tier.
PM5E.Ego.Confirm: Fuse {from} into “{to}”? The ingredients will be removed.
